question: What three disciplines are combined in nursing informatics?
explanation: Nursing informatics specifically brings together nursing knowledge with computer and information sciences to manage healthcare data effectively. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: Why is the shift from paper records to digital platforms important in healthcare?

options.A: It completely eliminates the need for any nursing documentation
options.B: It allows patients to prescribe their own medications online
options.C: It reduces medication errors and improves patient safety
options.D: It removes all responsibilities of data privacy from nurses

explanation: Digital platforms make patient information clearer and more accessible, which directly lowers the risk of medication mistakes. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h1)

question: What feature in Word helps save time when creating standard hospital forms?
explanation: Templates provide ready-made layouts so users do not have to design standard documents from scratch every time. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: How do headers and footers contribute to professional clinical reports?

options.A: They check the grammar and spelling of the entire document
options.B: They convert written text into animated multimedia presentations
options.C: They display page numbers and confidential disclaimers consistently
options.D: They automatically calculate the total budget for the ward

explanation: Headers and footers appear on every page to keep tracking information and privacy notices visible throughout the report. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h2)

question: What is the primary building block of an Excel spreadsheet?
explanation: Spreadsheets are structured grids made up of intersecting rows and columns to hold data. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: A community nurse wants to show the monthly trend of cholera cases visually to the local government. Which Excel tool should be used?
explanation: Charts and graphs turn raw numerical data into clear visual trends that are easy for community leaders to understand. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h3)

question: What is the main purpose of using PowerPoint in nursing practice?

options.A: Typing formal patient case notes and discharge summaries
options.B: Creating visual slide presentations for education and training
options.C: Storing encrypted electronic health records in a secure database
options.D: Managing complex mathematical formulas and financial budgets

explanation: PowerPoint is designed specifically for slide shows used during teaching, seminars, and health campaigns. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: Why should presenters avoid putting long paragraphs of text on PowerPoint slides?

options.A: It violates international nursing data privacy laws
options.B: It automatically deletes the file format when saved
options.C: It prevents the use of charts and graphs in the spreadsheet
options.D: It makes the slides cluttered and hard for the audience to read

explanation: Brevity and bullet points keep the audience focused on the speaker rather than reading dense text blocks. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h4)

question: What is the best practice regarding nursing computer workstation security?

options.A: Write your password on a sticky note attached to the monitor
options.B: Share your login details with junior colleagues to help them out
options.C: Log out or lock the screen whenever leaving the workstation
options.D: Leave clinical applications open so the next shift can use them easily

explanation: Locking the screen prevents unauthorized persons from viewing or altering confidential patient records while you are away. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)

question: Which of the following is NOT an acceptable practice when handling digital patient data?

options.A: Sharing your personal password with a colleague during a busy shift
options.B: Ensuring patient records are viewed only for authorized clinical care
options.C: Complying with hospital data protection policies and guidelines
options.D: Locking your computer screen every time you step away from the desk

explanation: Sharing passwords compromises account accountability and violates core data security and patient privacy principles. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T8#GNS113_U1_T8_h5)
